headline: Khaitan & Co, Hogan Lovells Cadwalader act on Netweb Technologies ₹1,200 crore QIP
sum: Netweb Technologies India Limited has made a qualified institutions placement of equity shares aggregating to approx. ₹1,200 crore.
detail: Netweb Technologies India Limited has made a qualified institutions placement of equity shares aggregating to approx. ₹1,200 crore. Khaitan & Co advised Netweb Technologies as well as the Book Running Lead Managers - IIFL Capital Services Limited, CLSA India Private Limited and Resurgent India Limited, on this QIP. The transaction team consisted of Oishik Bagchi (Partner), Dipen Chatterjee (Partner), Mainak Pal (Senior Associate), Associates Ayesha Khosla, Harshit Singh and Ahana Mukherjee.
